title: ULK1 on-bead in vitro kinase assay
projectDescription: Label-free phosphoproteomics of in vitro kinase assays. Three sets of bottom-up proteomics experiments were performed.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Mouse embryonic fiboblasts were lysed under native conditions. Protein complexes were immobilzed on NHS beads and in vitro kinase assays were performed. Proteins were digested in solution and peptides fractionated by high-pH RP prior phosphopeptide enrichment using TiO2 beads.
dataProcessingProtocol: Data was analysed by MaxQuant Version 1.6.2.10. Phospho(STY) was chosen as variable PTM. A full-length UNIPROT mouse database was used.
